summary: 1D float table lookup with linear interpolation. Guards on the input coordinate a2: when a2 >= 3.75 it returns the high-bound sentinel entry this[40] (offset 0xA0) directly; otherwise it scales the coordinate by 4.0, extracts an integer table index via CRTFtol, and linearly interpolates between adjacent entries this[idx+25] and this[idx+26] using the float-rounding remainder. Physics/vehicle subsystem; called per-frame by sub_4423B0 and sub_4EE2D0.

local_names.this: float table object; entry [40] at offset 0xA0 is the sentinel/high-bound value
local_names.a2: input coordinate, clamped at the 3.75 high bound
local_names.v7: float copy of v4; (v7 - v4) supplies the fractional interpolation factor

operations.description: If a2 >= 3.75, return this[40] (the sentinel/high-bound entry at offset 0xA0) without interpolating
Compute the double table coordinate v4 = a2 * 4.0 and keep a float copy v7 = v4; the float rounding loss (v7 - v4) later becomes the interpolation fraction
sub_5895A2(v4) processes the coordinate value before index extraction
CRTFtol(v4) truncates the coordinate to the integer table index v5
Linear interpolation between adjacent table entries: v6 = this[v5+25] (lower), result = (this[v5+26] - v6) * (v7 - v4) + v6
Return the interpolated value as a double
